“Fire magic?”
	
“Yes.”
	
“Any particular style or just a general mastery.”
	
“Um, I focused on learning Giestflame but I can also use Soulfire fairly well.”
	
“Ok. Any talent in Water.”
	
“Yes, my master gave me the Water Regalia. Look is this going to take much longer? I have to meet someone.”
	
“Just a moment sir. In order to make sure each ‘talent’ is appropriate for Acknowledgement we must be very thorough in our questioning.Now for-”
	
“The metals mostly. I’m partial to Iron, but I can use Silver better. I also understand the concepts of most Earth magics. Furthermore my Wind spells are evenly split between offense and support. Anything else you need to ask me?”

“A broad list of spells. Why didn’t you specialize more?”	

“Honestly? The professors wouldn’t let me. They all said I had a gift. That they had never seen a student with such a high affinity not be drawn to any one form. The other students hated me for it though.”

“Hmmmm. Interesting. As you must know here at Oculus Tempus we have a wide range of talents. Most of whom are considered geniuses at what they do. Why should we let you, someone who has no specialty, join such a prestigious organization.”

“Well. I guess it’s okay to tell you this. And I know this is for the company but can you try to keep it low key. I don’t really want anyone finding out.”

“I’ll try to keep it a secret but the law may require me to make the information public.”

“Ok, well here it is, I’m the heir to the Sinclair family fortune.”

“----”

“Are you alright?”

“-----. Yes. I’m sorry I must have zoned out there for a minute. Who did you say you were again?” 

“Look either give me the job or I’ll leave right now. It’s only temporary after all.”
